Since the left side of this expression is increasing in nss, a rise in yss, which implies a rise in the inflation rate, lowers the steady-state labor supply. Higher inflation taxes consumption and causes households to substitute toward more leisure. This is the source of the welfare cost of inflation in this CIA model.
